name: publishub-motion
description: Publishub · motion ad (Instagram Reels 9:16 e X 16:9) em Remotion

scripts.render: npm run sound && npm run render:reels && npm run render:x
scripts.render:v2: npm run sound:v2 && npm run render:reels-v2 && npm run render:x-v2
scripts.render:talking: npm run sound:talking && remotion render src/index.ts TalkingHead ../../../output/publishub-talking-head-final.mp4 --codec=h264 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --crf=16
scripts.render:demo: npm run sound:demo && npm run render:demo-en && npm run render:demo-pt
scripts.render:swipe: npm run sound:swipe && npm run render:swipe-en && npm run render:swipe-pt
scripts.render:film: npm run sound:film && remotion render src/index.ts Film ../publishub-launch-film-1920x1080.mp4 --codec=h264 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:audit-x: npm run sound:audit && remotion render src/index.ts AuditX ../publishub-audit-x.mp4 --codec=h264 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:ph: npm run sound:ph && remotion render src/index.ts PhDemo ../publishub-product-hunt-demo-1920x1080.mp4 --codec=h264 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:editors: npm run sound:editors && remotion render src/index.ts EditorsReel ../publishub-reel-editors-1080x1920.mp4 --codec=h264 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:caderno: npm run sound:caderno && remotion render src/index.ts ReelCaderno ../publishub-reel-caderno-1080x1920.mp4 --codec=h264 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:cortes: npm run sound:cortes && remotion render src/index.ts ReelCortes ../publishub-reel-cortes-1080x1920.mp4 --codec=h264 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:launch: npm run sound:launch && npm run srt:launch && npm run render:launch-vertical && npm run render:launch-landscape
